name: Kan'ochi x Motoyanzuma ~Gomennasai. Watashi, Mukatsuku Kouhai ni Niku Onaho ni Sarechatta no~
original_name: 完堕ちX元ヤン妻 ～ごめんなさい。私、ムカつく後輩に肉オナホにされちゃったの～
source:
Shogo Nimura was recently injured while working at a construction site and is currently at home. Although the injury itself has healed, he has lost the desire to work seriously.

One day, a new resident moves in next door. "Who's that? Minami-senpai?"

The two are surprised at the sudden reunion. The next day, Shogo starts to take action to get his hands on Minami's body.

The strong-willed wife resists at first, but her body, which has recently been sexless, becomes more obedient. 

This is a novel adventure game in which you train her to beg you and dominate her mind and body.
translation:
仁村翔吾最近在建筑工地工作时受伤，目前正在家中休养。虽然伤势已经痊愈，他却失去了认真工作的干劲。

某天，隔壁搬来了新的住户。“那不是……美海学姐吗？”

突如其来的重逢让两人都很惊讶。第二天，翔吾便开始行动，企图得到美海的身体。

起初，这位性格强势的人妻还会反抗，可长久缺乏性生活的身体，却逐渐变得顺从。

在这款文字冒险游戏中，你将调教她，让她主动乞求，将她的身心彻底掌控。
